newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn committee formally ends capital trading tax.
newsitem.headline: Bonn committee formally ends capital trading tax.

text.p: Germany's parliamentary mediation committee formally approved the abolition of the capital trading tax on companies, the upper house of parliament said in a statement on Monday.
The decision was official confirmation of an earlier agreement between the ruling coalition and the opposition Social Democrats (SPD) last Thursday.

The deal was the only portion of a sweeping reform of Germany's tax system proposed by the government to survive the mediation process. The SPD used its majority in the mediation committee to block the rest of the proposed tax reforms.
The lower house of parliament is to meet on Tuesday to debate the mediation committee's decisions.
